html:
The union of Bessarabia with Romania was voted on 9 April 1918 by the Sfatul Țării, the regional council in Chișinău, after the collapse of the Russian Empire.

The council had first declared a Moldavian Democratic Republic in late 1917. Romanian troops entered in January 1918, at the council's request, to fight Bolshevik bands. The vote for union followed. It was part of the Great Union that doubled Romania's size that year. The Soviet Union never accepted it and set up a Moldavian republic on the far bank of the Dniester in 1924. The twenty years of Romanian rule still feed the debate in Moldova over whether its people and language are Romanian.
sum: The union of Bessarabia with Romania was voted on 9 April 1918 by the Sfatul Țării, the regional council in Chișinău, after the collapse of the Russian Empire.
